Facts: Chen used his position as a business employee of a private company (Lanxi City Huifeng Textile Co., Ltd.) to embezzle company funds 50,000 RMB, used to pay his own purchase. He later returned the money. This is misappropriation of company funds, i.e., "挪用资金" which is a crime under the Criminal Law: "挪用资金罪" (embezzlement of public funds) but for private company it's "挪用公司、企业、事业单位、人民团体的资金罪"? Actually Chinese law: Article 382 of Criminal Law: "挪用公司、企业、事业单位、人民团体的资金罪" (embezzlement of funds of a company, enterprise, public institution, people's organization). The offense name is "挪用资金罪"? The typical naming: "挪用资金罪" is for public funds; for private it's "挪用公司、企业、事业单位、人民团体的资金罪". The instruction: "If the facts describe the misappropriation of money belonging to a private company or other non‑government entity (e.g., company funds, client payments) rather than state or public treasury funds, the ..." The rule seems truncated but likely says to charge "挪用公司、企业、事业单位、人民团体的资金罪". Also note: When listing crime name(s) between tags, output only statutory offense name without appending the character “罪”. So we should output "挪用公司、企业、事业单位、人民团体的资金". But maybe the official short name is "挪用资金". However they said not to append "罪". So we need the name without "罪". The correct charge: "挪用公司、企业、事业单位、人民团体的资金". That is the offense.

Any other crimes? He fled, but that's not a crime. He returned money, maybe mitigation. No bribery, no forgery. So single offense.
